At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

As a Software Engineer on the Engine Productivity team, you will build and maintain the test infrastructure that keeps Roblox's engine code healthy — code-coverage reporting, cross-platform unit-test harnesses (including PS4/5), the ReferenceClient, and the buck2 test system. This work is becoming mission-critical: as AI-assisted development dramatically increases the volume of code being generated, fast and trustworthy test signal is what keeps engine quality high.
You Have:
1–3 years of experience building software systems (internships or industry experience)
Strong coding fundamentals in C/C++ (with Python or a similar language for tooling, diagnostics, and data pipelines)
Genuine interest in debugging and program internals — curiosity about what the code actually does beyond the authored source (build output, generated code, harness and runtime behavior)
Conceptual familiarity with build configurations (i.e., maintaining different configs for different purposes and understanding why they diverge)
Strong data sense — the ability to tell whether a data aggregation is well constructed and whether it answers the right question
A track record of driving cross-org / cross-team initiatives to completion
You Will:
Own and evolve the code-coverage reporting pipeline, keeping both full and patch-level coverage signal fast and trustworthy
Build out additional diagnostics and reporting pipelines that surface the health of engine tests
Keep the unit-test harness healthy across platforms, including PS4/5
Maintain the ReferenceClient and help extend it into new integration-test scenarios
Ship improvements to the buck2 test system
Partner with senior and staff engineers to strengthen C++ unit testing — a growing priority as AI-assisted development produces more code that must be verified quickly and reliably
Please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time. You may redact age, date of birth, and dates of attendance/graduation from your resume if you prefer.

As a Software Engineer on the Discovery UX team, you'll build frontend features across discovery surfaces like Home and Search, helping users find games they'll love and developers find their audience. You'll design, build, and measure your own features, working with partners across Roblox. If you’re data-driven and passionate about building a cohesive user experience, you’ll be right at home on this team!
You Will:
Design, build, and ship features that define the discovery journey for millions of users
Drive UX improvements through rigorous A/B testing and deep-dive analysis of experiment results
Collaborate with teams across Roblox to ensure a coherent user experience across Web and App
You Have:
1–3 years of industry experience building web or mobile applications using technologies such as React, TypeScript, and JavaScript
A passion for understanding users and creating exceptional experiences for our community
The flexibility to work across areas such as backend systems and data infrastructure when needed to achieve project goals
An analytical mindset, with the ability to anticipate edge cases and use data to understand the impact of your work
Respect for your teammates and a commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive environment
